query: Orders API keeps hitting 504s after we shrank the database driver pool. How did we fix it before?
note: Every claim below is shown on screen in the same scene and was verified against the running app before recording.

segments.scene: Memory Explorer: open the stored past incident
segments.text: Agent Recall gives AI agents a memory. Here's a past incident it already knows: checkout timeouts after a connection pool change.

segments.scene: Search Playground: type a differently worded problem, Run all
segments.text: Now a new problem, worded differently. One click runs keyword search, semantic search, and a hybrid of both, so the old incident surfaces even without matching words.

segments.scene: Select memories, Use in agent task, grounded answer with citations
segments.text: Pick the most relevant memories, and the agent drafts a recommendation grounded in them, with citations back to the evidence.

segments.scene: Did this work? Worked + Helpful, Record outcome, new memory becomes Searchable
segments.text: The fix worked, so we record the outcome. It becomes a new verified memory, searchable within seconds.
